notes: Requirements are from the 2025-26 General Catalog PDF (Computer Science, B.S., 56 units of major courses). The catalog.fresnostate.edu program page returned empty to automated fetches, so the PDF was used. The department's BS information sheet is from 2013-14 and was not used. No course syllabus was found for any slot. C5 and C6 were added from the same catalog: no AI/ML course is required (C5 is an elective); C6 is the required operating systems course.
